calendarFaqs.q: When does Aldine ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The districtwide instructional calendar begins Wednesday, August 12, 2026. ADSY campuses begin July 27. See the ADSY section above for details about Smith Elementary.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Aldine ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of classes on the districtwide calendar is Thursday, June 3, 2027. ADSY campuses finish June 17. See the ADSY section above for details about Smith Elementary.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Aldine ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027. The fourth grading period begins Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Aldine ISD Midwinter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Midwinter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 5, 2027. Staff development is scheduled January 4–5, and classes resume January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Aldine ISD have Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The district does not label October 12–16 as Fall Break. Its official calendar lists those dates as a student holiday week, with staff development on October 12. Classes resume October 19.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Aldine ISD have an early-release day?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar lists one student half day on Friday, December 18, 2026. It is also a staff development day and the end of the second grading period.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Aldine ISD schools use the ADSY calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Aldine’s current ADSY PDF is labeled for Ermel, Harris, and Vines. The district’s 2026–27 calendar approval announcement also identifies Smith Elementary as an ADSY campus. Families at Smith should confirm the applicable calendar directly with the school or district.
